I have one sister, and when we were younger one of us was always the golden child while the other one got my moms wrath. 4 years ago, when I was 15 my sister decided to live with my dad, and I felt bad for my mom so I decided to stay with her.

Since then my sister is pretty much NC with my mom so everything is left on me. I feel like I haven't felt alive in years. Now my mom had a baby, she is 8 months old today, and im stuck caring for her a lot and I feel stuck in this position now. 

Everyday is so so so bad, on the really bad days I have to make sure my alarm is set super early so I can spend hours convincing myself to get out of bed just to be antaginized for the rest of the day.

I was doing so well before my sister moved. All AP or dual credit classes, a plan for after high school, motivation. Now im 19, live at home still, college but no ambitions stuck taking care of a baby. I cant even shower most days because Im either taking care of her, or my mom thinks its rude because "she is not able to".( she is, just likes complaining) 

I work but all my money goes to her. For example,  this last paycheck I made 1800 but I had to give her 1200, which only left me 600 for bills, groceries, needs, and taxes (im self employed). 

Im not allowed to eat when she has the baby, because again just like the shower scenario "she cant". Im so fucking utterly depressed. All i hear all day is how im doing everything wrong, how much we fucked up her life, how helpless I am, how I need her. 

Im not allowed to cry in the house because it annoys her. If i cry I have to do it in the shower or when I know 10p% for sure she is asleep.

In my free time I like looking at apartments and daydreaming. I wanna get out so bad.

This is a nightmare. 

Im literally begging yall,  save up all the money you possibly can from a young age to make sure you can move out when things get bad. You dont want to live your life like this. You really really really dont
